title: Migrations, Factories, Config & Providers
intro: Applies to: migrations, model factories, config files, service providers, scheduled tasks.

entries.rule: A migration **MUST** have a `down()` that actually reverses it, or a clearly intentional irreversible note.

checks.coverage: Flags a migration whose down() method has an empty body and no irreversible note.

entries.rule: PHP FQCNs **MUST NOT** be stored in database columns (defaults, seeds, morph types); use plain string identifiers and a morph map.
Lifecycle state **MUST** be a `status` string column cast to a backed enum, with an index, never a `boolean('is_active')`-style flag (see `models-domain.md`).

Cross-module references **MUST** be plain id columns with no `->foreign()`; a same-module foreign key **MAY** exist. A migration **MUST NOT** touch a table owned by another module (see `isolation.md`).

checks.coverage: Flags a ->foreign() call in a migration that references a table owned by another module.

entries.rule: New domain tables **MUST** use primary keys consistent with the project's non-enumerable public-id strategy (ULID/UUIDv7/snowflake).

entries.note: Facades, helpers, and `Schema`/`DB` are fine inside migrations.

entries.rule: Every model **MUST** ship a factory: `final class`, typed `definition(): array`, named states via `->state(...)` for every meaningful lifecycle position. Exception: read-model factories may be non-`final` (see `filament.md`).

checks.coverage: Flags a model factory class that is not declared final, outside read-model factories.

entries.note: Factories use only framework/package traits, like all other classes.

entries.rule: `env()` **MUST** appear only in config files; nowhere else in the codebase.

checks.coverage: Flags an env() call outside the config directory.

entries.rule: Descriptive header comment blocks in config files **MAY** exist (they are not what-narration).

entries.note: The module service provider owns all wiring: `Bus::map([...])` for command/query handlers, explicit `Event::listen($event, $listener)` per listener, singleton bindings for connectors/gateways, `Schedule::job(...)`/`Schedule::command(...)` for scheduled tasks.

entries.rule: Event auto-discovery and `$listen` arrays **MUST NOT** be used; every listener registration is explicit and greppable.
entries.why: every listener registration is explicit and greppable

checks.coverage: Flags a $listen property or event auto-discovery enabled on an event service provider.

entries.rule: Facades and helpers **MAY** be used in providers.
The app service provider **MUST** enable strict Eloquent mode and unguard models (`Model::shouldBeStrict()`, `Model::unguard()`), and register the morph map.

entries.note: File-shape rules (`strict_types`, `final readonly`, promotion) are owned by `orchestration-di.md` and apply to migrations, factories, and config too; cross-reference it, do not re-audit them here.
